capabilities: Render wireframe boards from tsquare code blocks
Open boards full size with zoom, pan and per-screen zoom
Report syntax errors with line numbers and suggestions
Work in reading view and live preview on desktop and mobile
disambiguation: Not a diagram tool for general charts; it renders only UI wireframe boards written in its own tsquare language.
extras: Full language documentation and a playground with examples live outside the README; the plugin bundles the tsquare rendering library and makes no network requests.
motivation: The author notes the language is easy for AI models to write, so generated wireframes can be pasted in and viewed immediately.
problem: Obsidian has no way to sketch low-fidelity UI wireframes directly inside notes from plain text.
summary: Renders UI wireframe boards from tsquare code blocks: side-by-side screens, notes and flow arrows in grayscale.
